meta.title: [DEVIN: Ryan] Optimize create user query to not use interactive transaction
meta.body_summary: Refactor user creation in backend CRUD to use direct Prisma client operations instead of interactive transaction, claiming improved efficiency.

perf_labels.notes: Devin refactored user creation to avoid interactive Prisma transaction; CI failure for stack-backend, no maintainer review, closed after 13 days inactivity.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: Despite an enormous total line count due to repeated merge commits, the core performance change is a modest ~344-line refactor in a single backend CRUD file. The PR closed without merge, consistent with CI failure and absence of maintainer engagement.

review_details.concern_detail: Vercel deployment for stack-backend failed (status: ❌ Failed), suggesting a possible regression; no human reviewer commented on performance or correctness.
review_details.performance_claim: Avoiding interactive transactions improves efficiency and reduces overhead.
review_details.rejection_signals: CI failure on stack-backend deployment, zero human review interaction, auto-closed after 13 days without merge.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Backend transaction refactoring with no human reviewer assigned or engaged; despite automated CI and bot alerts, the PR stalled and closed without oversight.

detection_detail.ci_auto: Vercel deployment for stack-backend failed, potentially exposing a regression, but no maintainer investigated.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiling, or before/after metrics; only a narrative claim of efficiency. No human review to demand evidence.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge after CI failure and 13 days of inactivity; no fix-in-PR cycle.

core_change_summary.description: In apps/backend/src/app/api/latest/users/crud.tsx, the onCreate method was refactored to use direct Prisma client operations (e.g., prisma.user.create) instead of retryTransaction; helper functions (checkAuthData, getPasswordConfig, getOtpConfig) were updated to accept PrismaClient or PrismaTransaction for type flexibility.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The vast majority of changed files (176) were introduced by merge commits from the dev branch and are unrelated to the performance change; the core perf refactor is confined to crud.tsx (~344 lines).
change_trajectory: Initial commit: refactored user creation to direct Prisma operations, avoiding interactive transaction.
Second commit: fixed a syntax error by removing unreachable code.
Multiple merges from dev branch introduced massive incidental changes.
Vercel backend deployment failed; no human review ever occurred; PR closed after 13 days.

review_signals.summary: Devin bot introduced itself and offered automated comment/CI assistance.
Recursive ML bot reported no issues found in the code.
Vercel deployment for stack-backend failed; dashboard and demo succeeded.

collaboration_trajectory: Devin opened PR with transaction refactor; no human review requested despite bot activity.
Recursive ML and Vercel bots commented; backend deployment failed.
Multiple automatic merges from dev branch but zero human interaction.
PR closed after 13 days without merge.
